record_type_quote: The results presented in this study evaluated these optimized forms in data from an additional independent randomized pediatric schizophrenia trial (Savitz et al., 2015 ). Overall, these results support three previous studies showing that the PANSS10 and PANSS20 compare favorably to the 30-item PANSS in terms of content coverage, reliability, validity, and calibration, with a significant reduction in administration length (Busner et al., 2024 ; Findling et al., 2023 ; Youngstrom et al., 2024 ).
